'''Ronko Bist''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] and a member of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Bist was the leader of a group of faction called the [[Free Trandoshans]], and served as [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku's]] liaison to the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Bist was maimed by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and arrested by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. He was then imprisoned within [[The Prism]].

After the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the subsequent [[Ghost Prison incident|Gentis coup]], Bist was released and became part of a [[Mission to the Prism#Prism_riot|brutal test]] created by [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Vader, to see who among the prisoners was worthy of joining the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]. Bist was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the battle.
